content:
maria_cs: Looping in @ben_sec and @olivia_legal — SageWell sent a DPA + SOC2 checkpoint. They asked for: embeddings pseudonymization approach, retention policy for embeddings, BYOK feasibility (and a quick one-pager + evidence bundle) by Wed 2026-04-14. Sam (customer) is on thread.

sam_sagewell: Thanks Maria — we need concise bullets we can add to our vendor review. BYOK preferred but we can accept hosted if keys are managed and not exportable.

ben_sec: @maria_cs quick clarifying Q: are we currently indexing raw PII in embeddings or storing pseudonymized IDs only? If raw PII is embedded, recommend redaction + deterministic hashing before onward storage.

sam_sagewell: We ingest free-text support transcripts; there can be PHI/PII occasionally. We need actionable guidance we can implement quickly.

olivia_legal: For the DPA we also need subprocessors + transfer flows. Note: BYOK is only available on Dedicated/Private. For hosted, we can offer SSE with customer-managed KMS if they provision via cloud marketplace integration (we can document limits). :thinking_face:

ben_sec: Draft answer we can send to SageWell (short bullets):
- Pseudonymization: recommend deterministic hashing (salted) + redaction for explicit identifiers
- Retention: configurable; default embeddings retention = 90 days, cache TTL = 30 days (can be shortened per contract)
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest with KMS-wrapped keys; TLS in transit
- BYOK: supported only on Dedicated/Private deployments; hosted has customer-managed KMS option with limited key lifecycle controls

ben_sec: Small example snippet for their security team:
```
embeddings_retention_days: 90
pseudonymization: deterministic_sha256(salt)
encryption: kms_wrapped_keys, AES-256-GCM
```

maria_cs: Can @tom_ops own collecting the sample logs, sanitized dataflow diagram, and the minimal evidence bundle for upload? I can draft the one-pager language for the customer.

tom_ops: I can pull a sample from staging and scrub identifiers. Will remove user IDs and replace with deterministic hashes. ETA: EOD Tue.

jira-bot: Created JIRA ticket INF-3245: "SageWell DPA evidence + embeddings plan" assigned to tom_ops, due 2026-04-13.

deploy-bot: Artifact `dpa-evidence-bundle-178765` uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/sagewell/ (access: restricted to support+security).

olivia_legal: We need a SOC2 excerpt confirming scope includes hosting and processing for embeddings. @ben_sec can you attach a control mapping (encryption, logging, subprocessors) to INF-3245? :eyes:

ben_sec: Adding a quick mapping now: Control E2 (Encryption) -> AES-256 + KMS; Control L1 (Logging) -> token-level access logs retained 90d; Subprocessors -> list in infra-subprocessors.xlsx. I'll add the docs to the JIRA ticket.

sam_sagewell: That sounds good — once we have the one-pager + sample logs we'll forward to our legal ops and get back with follow-ups.

maria_cs: Great — plan: tom uploads sanitized bundle -> I finalize one-pager -> ben/olivia confirm controls -> handoff to Sam by Wed COB. Thanks team :thumbsup:
